en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we talk about?
I've gotten used to being here...
I want to get outside as soon as I can...
Staying here forever wouldn't be so bad
Yeah, but...

That doesn't mean we should 
stay here forever.

There are people waiting 
to see my magic shows...

I can't just sit around in 
a place like this!
Hm, you're right!

When I think about it both realistically
and magically, I want to get out too!

Once I'm out, I'll make the biggest 
magic show ever and astound the world!

Hey, are you serious?
Are you just tired or something?

Be careful you don't get caught 
by a dark mage!

They're the best at manipulating 
weakened human souls!
Huh!?
Don't tell me one already got you!?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Himiko looks deep in thought...
(Nyeh...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Himiko's inner thoughts...?
